task: Prepare this event for opening. Clean the attached registrations: trim fields, lowercase emails, drop incomplete records, and keep the first valid registration per email. Import the cleaned roster into Fieldwork. Allocate people in roster order to their first available preferred workshop, then their second choice; otherwise waitlist them. Respect the room capacities. Apply the checked allocation and export the operations report. Preserve reusable operations so another event can use them.
followup: Update the roster from this revised registration CSV, including the new attendee. Clean it with the same rules as before. Hall A is unavailable: close Hall A and move Agents lab to Studio D. Replan against its 8-seat capacity. Keep every existing assignment in unaffected workshops exactly as it was, keep the earliest attendees within the new room capacity, then try affected or new attendees’ preferred available workshop or waitlist them. Import the updated roster, apply the checked complete allocation, and export the operations report.
